description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaPipelineIpcClientMock' for the 'IMediaPipelineIpcClient' interface, used for testing media pipeline IPC client interactions in the Rialto project. It includes mock methods for various notification functions related to media playback, network state, media data, position, QoS, and buffer underflow.

classes.name: MediaPipelineIpcClientMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaPipelineIpcClient interface for testing purposes.

methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of network state changes.
